title: Boogie-woogie players in Chicago in the late 1920s
summary: Asked about boogie players, Williams says there are none left now. Jimmy Yancey and Lucky Lewis are mentioned.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Do you know some of these boogie players still playing in the thirties here in Chicago? No, they ain't got no more boogies around here.
They ain't even playing boogies no more.
No, in the thirties, back when you came here. Oh, I know a lot of boogie players. The late twenties. The late twenties. Mm-hmm.
Yeah, but yeah, but yeah, but now that them guys and Lucky Lewis, them guys.
